description: This file defines data structures, models, and logic related to managing session data within an application. It includes Codable structs for server responses, session representation, token statistics, and session loading logic using async functions and error handling. It also provides utility functions for date formatting and class previews.

methods.name: loadSnapshot
methods.description: Asynchronously loads session snapshot data from a remote source, decodes JSON, and maps it to internal models.

methods.name: loadRows
methods.description: Asynchronously loads session rows using loadSnapshot.

methods.name: standardize
methods.description: Helper method to standardize file paths.

methods.name: relativeAge
methods.description: Computes a human-readable relative age string from a given date.
